_comment: Who sounds like whom, per locale. One entry per speaker id used in
data/dialogues; a speaker with no entry here goes unvoiced and the line
stays a caption, which is the fallback the game is built around.
LICENCE RULE. LICENSE-ASSETS.md forbids anything non-commercial or
no-derivatives from entering this repository, and a rendered line inherits
the licence of the voice that read it. Only models whose dataset is CC0,
public domain, CC BY or Apache 2.0 may be named here. That rules out some
of the best-sounding Piper voices — en_US-ryan, en_US-hfc_male, ru_RU-ruslan
and zh_CN-xiao_ya are all CC BY-NC-SA, and en_US-lessac carries the Blizzard
research licence. Check a voice before adding it: its MODEL_CARD at
huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices names the dataset licence. The .onnx.json
beside the model does not.
This is why Russian leans on two voices and Mandarin on one: those are the
clean-licensed ones. See docs/VOICE.md.
model      - a Piper voice (python3 -m piper.download_voices lists them all)
length     - Piper's --length-scale: above 1.0 is slower, and slower is older,
heavier, more certain of itself
noise      - Piper's --noise-scale: how much the delivery wanders
pitch      - post-shift in semitones, applied with ffmpeg. This is what keeps
two characters apart when a locale has fewer clean voices than it
has parts to fill
echo       - ffmpeg aecho tail, for the things that speak without a body
gain_db    - trim, so no one is twice as loud as the person they answer
THE WOMEN ARE ENGLISH AND UKRAINIAN ONLY, and that is the licence rule
again rather than a choice. Piper's clean-licensed voices are almost all
male: ru_RU-irina and zh_CN-huayan state no licence at all, and
zh_CN-xiao_ya is non-commercial, so Russian and Mandarin have no female
voice this repository may ship. Sister Agnes, Mara and the crone stay
captions in those two languages, which is what an unvoiced line has
always been. Pitching a man up to stand in for them was the alternative
and it is worse than silence.
PITCH IS SMALL NOW, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. Shifting a voice with a
resampler drags its formants along — the resonances that say 'a human
throat about this size' — so four semitones down stops being a deeper
man and starts being a tape running slow. generate_speech.py now shifts
with the WORLD vocoder, which moves the pitch and leaves the formants,
and the shifts themselves are kept inside a couple of semitones. Two men
are told apart by pace and by Piper's noise knobs, which is what those
are for.
`formants: false` opts out, and exactly two parts use it: the voice in
the dark and the Ophanim, neither of which is a person. For them the
sliding formants are the effect.

SPEAKER_ELIAN._note: The hanged man. Tired, flat, says less than he knows.

SPEAKER_ANGEL._note: Not kind, not cruel. Even, unhurried, slightly too high to be human.

SPEAKER_STRANGER._note: Close to the ear, never raised. The only one who asks a question back.

SPEAKER_VOICE._note: No body and no name. Deep, slow, arriving from further away than the room.

SPEAKER_OPHANIM._note: Wheels full of eyes. Grand, certain, and - by the end - confused.

SPEAKER_KNIGHT_OF_ASH._note: He burned a town on a voice's word. Low, slow, burnt through; every line sounds like the last thing he will say.

SPEAKER_PREACHER._note: Blind, preaching to a nave with nobody in it. Fast, pressing.

NPC_MATTHEW._note: He signed the sentence. Old, careful, picking every word.

NPC_SEVERIN._note: The watchman who buried him and wrote it down. Tired, plain, not unkind.

NPC_KNIGHT._note: Knight of the Watch. Two lines, both of them orders.

SPEAKER_NARRATOR._note: Nobody. The game saying what happened, with no mouth behind it.

NOTE_GATE_LOG._note: A record found in a cache, read out in Elian's voice — the words are not his.

NOTE_PREACHER_LETTERS._note: A record found in a cache, read out in Elian's voice — the words are not his.

NOTE_CRYPT_NAMES._note: A record found in a cache, read out in Elian's voice — the words are not his.

NPC_NUN._note: Sister Agnes. Certain of the order of things, and afraid of what is outside it.

NPC_MARA._note: Hunting the priest. Young, hard, in a hurry.

NPC_VILLAGER._note: The crone in the swamp. Old, slow, and past being frightened.
